text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: —Yaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAAAAAAAHH!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: (I can feel it—)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(That even at this very moment, my power 
is being honed to a razor edge...!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(To surpass McQueen's running, my own 
stride is evolving right now. But—)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: At this rate, I'm going to lose...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(Find it! Seize the path to victory right 
here, right now!!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: (I know I can do it—)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(That is the running style my Trainer and 
I have built together up to this day!!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(Put every single experience until now to 
use!!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(Positioning, race development, track 
conditions—— grasp it all through your 
experience!!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(The moment to make my winning move is 
now――!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Right here!!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ――OOAAAAHH!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus! It's Ikuno Dictus! Ikuno 
Dictus takes the leaaad!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: ――Across the finish line!!
(WOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, ha, haa, haa――

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(Using every ounce of my experience... 
I've seized a path to victory—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ikuno-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...It is a complete defeat. Refreshingly 
so."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: McQueen-san—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I thought I understood your strength 
better than anyone in this world. And yet—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...You grew even over the course of 
today's race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Far stronger than I had ever 
anticipated... she truly shone in this 
race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: By that brilliance, I—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Even though it was right in the middle of 
a race, I found myself completely 
captivated.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm happy. Hearing you say that, I 
mean."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...How are you feeling?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
No problem. There is fatigue, but it 
remains well within acceptable limits.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Impressive as always. Well then—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Please keep that up, and continue running 
for a long, long time to come.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"And please show me that radiance once 
more. Again and again, whenever you wish—"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes. I promise.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
For a long time... longer than anyone 
else, I will keep running and shine with 
an even greater brilliance from now on.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
As many times as it takes... until you are 
completely enchanted by me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Well... Heheh—
(WOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus is seriously amazing...! To 
beat Mejiro McQueen at the very end of a 
brutal rotation like that...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Her administrative skills are just insane. 
It's like... you get this total feeling of 
security, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
...It's just so reassuring to watch her. 
Ikuno Dictus, always standing tall and 
dignified like that.

—And so, Ikuno Dictus magnificently seized 
victory in the Takarazuka Kinen, putting 
the full fruits of her self-management on 
display.
—A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —Excuse me.
choice_data_list: How tired are you feeling?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I was able to get into 
shape. We should be able to head into the 
summer training camp without any issues 
now.
choice_data_list:
Alright, let's finally set our goals for 
autumn and beyond.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes.

Ikuno Dictus had told me in advance that 
she had "a proposal regarding our goals 
for the autumn season and beyond" today...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —I want to complete it.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
A way of running, a way of winning, unique 
only to me. I want that to bear fruit in 
my main battlegrounds, the Mile and 
Middle-distance GⅠ races—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: What I want to propose for that is—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Entering both the Queen Elizabeth II Cup 
and the Mile Championship."
choice_data_list:
Well now... this rotation is just like 
you...!

Well now... this rotation is just like 
you...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I had a feeling that's what you would say, 
Trainer.

Both the Queen Elizabeth II Cup and the 
Mile Championship are G1 races held at 
Kyoto Racecourse.

First, the Queen Elizabeth II Cup is a 
2,200m turf middle-distance GⅠ race mostly 
entered by Umamusume who ran the Tiara 
route.

"Next is the 'Mile Championship,' which, 
alongside the 'Yasuda Kinen,' is a 1600m 
turf GⅠ race that decides the strongest 
miler of that year—"

These two races are held close together in 
time, much like the Yasuda Kinen and the 
Takarazuka Kinen.

Running in both would naturally put a 
heavy strain on her and make for a 
grueling rotation, but—

—That was precisely why Ikuno Dictus chose 
it.

As her Trainer, I've already come to 
understand her intentions.
choice_data_list:
It wasn't just about running a grueling 
schedule—

text_block_list.text:
She had already achieved that by safely 
running and completing all four races: the 
Spring Senior Triple Crown and the Yasuda 
Kinen.

The realm she aims for next lies even 
further ahead. After pushing through a 
grueling rotation—
choice_data_list:
So you'll perfect your running style and 
aim for the top.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: That is correct.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...During the recent Takarazuka Kinen, I 
caught a glimpse of the absolute peak of 
my running."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Desperately racking my brain, trying to 
figure out how to overcome McQueen-san—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Comparing her past race experience against 
the conditions of the race at hand—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Searching for a path to victory, finding 
it, executing it, and claiming the 
win......—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
My greatest weapon. I became convinced 
that it was the experience gained from 
running so many races.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...By utilizing the 'maintenance' and 
'management' routines I established by 
spring to run through this grueling series 
of races—"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I want to sharpen my greatest weapon— my 
"experience"—even further...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"By establishing a track record for this 
weapon at the Queen Elizabeth II Cup and 
the Mile CS, I want to reach even greater 
heights...!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...What do you think?

It was a thrilling proposal. To shape a 
running style only Ikuno Dictus could 
achieve, and aim for the very pinnacle—

It will surely become a light that 
strengthens her hoofprints and her prayers 
for the future.
And that is precisely why—
choice_data_list: Let's enter the All Comers too.

text_block_list.text:
If race experience can serve as a weapon, 
then I want to gain even more of it before 
my ultimate goal.

"—The All Comers is a 2,200m turf 
medium-distance GII race held at Nakayama 
Racecourse right after the summer training 
camp ends."

"Both in terms of timing and distance, it 
would be a fitting race to test the fruits 
of summer training camp heading into 
autumn."

With the experience from the All Comers in 
hand, I'll head into the Queen Elizabeth 
II Cup and the Mile Championship in peak 
condition...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —That is an excellent plan.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Then let's make our next goal the All 
Comers.
choice_data_list:
That's where you'll show your true worth 
even more!
Show your true worth even further there!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I am looking forward to it.

And so, as our post-autumn goals were 
decided—

—A noticeable change began to show around 
me.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
“—I see. By sharing quantitative data with 
your Umamusume through the app like this, 
you improve the precision of your 
management.”

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I didn't study hard enough... I need to 
learn more about what I can do for 
post-race aftercare—

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Hey, could you share the details of this 
isometric training with me later? I'd like 
to try it with my girl too.
choice_data_list: (I-I'm so busy...!)

text_block_list.text:
Lately, my colleagues have often been 
asking me about the maintenance and 
management routine I do with Ikuno Dictus.

All of them uniformly showed a desire to 
improve something so their assigned 
Umamusume could run in better health...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
“—I see. So that is what has been 
happening.”
choice_data_list: Yeah. Actually, I think it's a good trend.

text_block_list.text:
If each and every one of us can improve 
even a little bit, I know it'll lead 
toward a brighter future someday.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. It is necessary for what we are 
aiming for.
choice_data_list:
...There was just something I've been 
thinking about.

text_block_list.text:
"...This is the first time I've mentioned 
this even to Ikuno Dictus."
choice_data_list:
I want to spread the word about "IRON 
WILL" more.

text_block_list.text:
To be more precise, what was poured into 
"IRON WILL." The journey of myself and 
Ikuno Dictus—
choice_data_list: I want to share that through "IRON WILL".

text_block_list.text:
The management records contained within 
"IRON WILL." Boasting perhaps the greatest 
level of detail and volume in this world, 
backed by proven results, it was living 
data.

And the AI trained on this data has also 
grown into an extremely reliable 
advisor...

"I thought that widely sharing IRON WILL 
would surely accelerate our progress 
toward the future we desire, but..."
choice_data_list: ...Do you not want to?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ? Why is that?
choice_data_list: Because it's your unvarnished data.
Because it's your unvarnished data.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Ah— ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for your concern. 
However, I am fine. Rather—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I'm almost proud of it.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
To show the world the path we have walked 
together.
choice_data_list: Ikuno...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Now I want to win the autumn GⅠ races 
even more.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: To make our stride even stronger.
choice_data_list: ...You're right!
...Yeah, you're right!

text_block_list.text:
—And so, Ikuno Dictus and I began taking 
our steps toward our new goal.

First is the All Comers after the summer. 
Let's make sure she can showcase her newly 
evolved running there...!
